title: Configurator Service State
description: Routes a pipeline value to another service's `configure()` call instead of continuing downstream. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/configurator)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

targetServiceUuid.description: UUID of the service to configure

targetRuntime.description: Runtime ID for cross-runtime targeting; omit for same-runtime

passThrough.description: When true, the original value continues downstream after configuring the target

pipeline.description: Optional transform pipeline applied to params before configure() is called
